hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using a custom curve invariant (CurveLib), takes input tokens into Euler vaults via depositAssets, withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting directly — bypassing standard v4 concentrated liquidity.
